notes.title: The Dungeon-Update is finally here!
notes.notes:
🧙‍♂️ Hello Fellow Mages!

This update has been long overdue — thank you all for your patience and support!
I’ve worked hard to squash gamebreaking bugs, polish core systems, and add tons of new content. While I can’t promise absolute perfection, if you find anything weird or broken, please reach out — I’ll jump on it right away!

🔥 Major Changes:

    🧠 Bosses rebalanced

    ⚔️ Tons of new upgrades

    🏃‍♂️ Faster-paced gameplay

    🌲 Skill Tree added!

    🕸 THE DUNGEON — crawl, survive, discover

    🏆 Achievements — now live!

🧩 BIG ROOM UPDATE

The dungeon has expanded — and so has the feature set:
🛠 New Systems & Features:

    📊 New Tab/Stats overlay

    🗂 Categorized upgrades by rarity

    💎 Room & Chest rarity reworked

    ⚙️ Circle Sliders for smoother control

    🧪 Synergies — try mixing certain upgrades!

    "What’s synergy?"
    It's when two or more upgrades combine to create unexpected (and sometimes broken) effects. Test things. Break things. Have fun with it 😏

🆕 New Upgrades:

    Concentrated Blast

    Expire Explosion

    Shielding

    AxeStrike

    ShortPiercing

    CircleExplosion

    IceField

🐞 Bugs? What Bugs?

Many bugs were squashed manually. Others… just vanished when I refactored the systems they were tied to. Call it accidental magic. And some might have dodged my ever-steady gaze. So if you find any report them!

The era of Path to Magehood is coming to a close. I’m super excited about where this is going — and even more excited to hear your thoughts.

To everyone that has played so far:
Thanks for being on this journey with me. Its my dream and my passion.

— Now1K 🪄

notes.title: Major Summertime Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Mages!

For the big Steam Summer Sale, I have planned to introduce a big update and here it is!
If you have ideas of your own or buggs to report. You can join my Discord and dm me there, or put your ideas into the corresponding channels:
https://discord.gg/Xscr8yDZZC
New Content:

    New Boss: Rot, morphed into a beholder *-*.
    New Map: Explore the sewer, with new obstacles. The firespirits got infested!

Now to go into more detail, if you want to know more:
Adjustments and Balancing:

    NEW UPGRADE: The acid upgrade-chain. An option to explosion-size.
    Removed xpChance ugrade. Now you always get xp on kill.
    Adjusted Spawnrates, xp you get from enemies and special mob spawns.
    Explosions now are more see through.
    Less Firespirits: Reduced the number of Firespirits spawning later in the game.
    Health-Related Upgrades Nerfed: These were overpowered, so they've been balanced.
    Death Bonus: If you die after surviving for at least one minute, you receive a flat amount of 3000 killpoints. Combo points are now worth less, but still valuable. This change ensures the early stages of the game don't drag on.
    Hunter does not regain cooldown of his ultimate during shadowstep anymore.
    Butcher Mob: The Butcher now slices through your projectiles effortlessly. He can only be damaged when charging or after his spin, as intended.
    Scaling Adjustments: Scaling now ticks every 8 seconds (nerfed scaling). The scaling-upgrade has been buffed to accommodate this change.
    Adjusted Combo Game: To fit with new spawning rates.
    Recoil/Knockback Upgrades Buffed: The Wizard now starts with a small amount of base recoil.
    Also The Club is simply stronger now.

And probably much more I just forgot I did!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44855563/95fdaaaea6103319972e8f6d254ff26e1b6e2a4f.png

Bug Fixes:

    Fixed Upgrade Descriptions: Certain upgrades now show the correct descriptions (they didn't before).
    Removed the first boss, who had too many buggs.
    Enemy Projectiles: Fixed an issue where enemy projectiles were affected by knockback.
    No Cost Upgrade (Sharpshooter Path): Now works only during Shadowstep, not always.
    Projectile Cost Fix (Arcane Path): Resolved issues with projectiles costing 2 less.
    Big boom counts in multishots now. (but not backshot, as it is intended)

Get ready to dive into the updated game with balanced gameplay, exciting new content, and essential bug fixes. Enjoy the new challenges and improvements in this summer update!

notes.title: Summertime-Update coming next week!
notes.notes:
Greetings Mages!

Exciting news! Path to Magehood is participating in the Steam Summer Sale! To celebrate, the sale I will soon release one of the biggest updates yet. This upcoming update is packed with new features, balancing tweaks, and bug fixes that will enhance your gameplay and keep you coming back for more. 

A new boss will enter the dungeon and a new map will be offering some variety in visuals and obstacles.

notes.title: Quick hotfix hotfix
notes.notes:
Nerfed Range in Firerate again, but it's still strong.

Added two new upgrades:

Sharp/Arcane Ultimate Shield: Part of their respective Path (Sharpshooter or Arcane Mage). When the cooldown of your Ultimate is up and you would be damaged, don't lose health. Instead, trigger the Ultimate with a Firerate surge.
Fixing a bug where after killing a boss, going again instantly makes all mobs spawn from minute zero.

F no longer creates screenshots.

notes.title: Balance hotfix!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Quick update for you:

ComboChain Added: Now, holding a 5x Combo for a long is more difficult.
Range is Firerate Capped: The maximum firerate buff is now capped at +100%.

Balance Hotfix:
I noticed the game was unwantedly too difficult after 5 minutes, my bad! Nerfed every mob's HP after 5 minutes. Apologies for the oversight!

notes.title: Biggest Update yet!
notes.notes:
NEW CONTENT!

NEW CHARACTER!
Introducing the Hunter in this patch! His special ability grants a burst of speed, increased fire rate, and damage, while rendering him invulnerable for a few precious seconds. The Hunter comes with unique stats, starting with less damage and smaller explosion size, but compensating with a higher fire rate, range and piercing +1.

NEW ENEMIES!
A maniac, the Butcher, joins the fray. Watch out as he slices apart projectiles until he gets close enough to charge. Dodge wisely, and you can turn the tables on his audacity! (spawns minute 5)
The thick skinned Zomby-giant joins aswell. He scales with your power but periodically needs to rest, allowing you to strike decisively during this moment. (spawns minute 7)

NEW UPGRADES: 
Sharpshooter Path (6 new Upgrades). See more info ingame under the stats menu.

Big Boom: Every 5th shot is doubled in size and damage.
(Enhances chance for:)

Big Boom Plus: Experience a Big Boom on every second shot.

BALANCE CHANGES:

More small fries will spawn in the first three minutes, gradually decreasing afterward.
Adjusted level requirements to fit the new spawnrates.

The Boss can only be spawned at minute 10 now.

These changes aim to enhance your gaming experience. Please write me, if you encounter buggs or have a tough time with something ingame. Happy playing, and may your shots always find their mark!

notes.title: First update since release.
notes.notes:
This is the first swift update for my game post-release, and it certainly won't be the last! This iteration incorporates several quality-of-life enhancements, such as the door opening faster and a boost to the MaxMana Metaupgrade (+20->+40). Aswell as spelling mistakes that have been fixed. Additionally, the in-game Boss indication will now accurately reflect the current boss you are facing. So, if you haven't defeated the boss yet, it will display 1, indicating that you are currently about to face the first boss.

I do intend on improving old and creating new content, such as new bosses or stages. This process will take its time, as I want to release these bugg-free.

Thank you to everyone that has already acquired and played Path to Magehood! Do not hesitate to send me your ideas or the buggs you (hopefully don't) encounter.
